description: Local APIC timers and interprocessor interrupts finite independent example
verification_method: research/v3/verify_fixtures.py independently recomputes this declared finite example; implementation and hardware evidence remain separate
mechanism_contract: An IPI asks another struct lr_cpu to act; it is not proof that the action has completed. Acknowledgment needs a separate generation or sequence. Timer counts require calibration and measurement bounds; QEMU virtual timing is not physical cycle accuracy.
required_observation: Show each struct lr_cpu receiving its own timer events and complete a directed IPI round trip with a bounded timeout and matching sequence.
